relation_rows: saved seed and degree-2/3 Hecke relations wholly internal to each selected column set
subset_law: retain anchored generator column, then first table_size-1 other original columns under SHA-256 of ASCII 'hecke-shift-density/v1:' plus seed label plus ':' plus decimal original column index
edge_rule: for every retained projected point Q, test Q+jG for every positive j no greater than radius; include exact point hits that survive in the selected table
work_accounting: record table_size times radius point-lookup probes, all successful directed edges, and the minimal number of shifted edges needed for the graph spanning forest; naive per-point generation costs radius curve additions and radius lookups
rank_rule: contract all included shift edges, reduce retained Hecke rows to component variables, append anchored log(G)=1, and compute exact GF(4021) rank and zero-incidence component count
validation: independently check all point identities and saved logs, then recompute every component rank and edge count with Sage
